requirements.title: Automation Test Engineer (Web and Mobile)
ambiguities: Mobile automation is listed as a responsibility (iOS and Android), but Appium is only a nice-to-have. Is mobile test automation experience required, and are tools other than Appium acceptable (e.g. Detox, Maestro, XCUITest, Espresso)?
The CI requirement says 'GitHub Actions or similar'. Which other CI tools count as similar (e.g. GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI)?
API testing may be done with 'Postman or code-based' tests. Is there a preferred language or library for code-based API tests (e.g. Playwright API testing, REST Assured, Supertest)?
'Basic cloud knowledge' does not name a provider. Does it mean AWS, GCP or Azure, or a device cloud such as BrowserStack or Sauce Labs?
'Ownership of a framework or suite' is not specific. Do you need someone who designed a framework from scratch, or someone who maintained and extended an existing one?

The shortlist is the same as before: CV-003, CV-042, CV-037. It rests only on job-related evidence: Playwright and TypeScript, API testing, Docker, CI and automation depth.

I can help with these instead:
- If the real concern is seniority or cost, I can change the minimum years of automation experience or raise the weight on experience level.
- If the client wants more test-architecture experience (your reason for rejecting CV-002), I can give more weight to automation depth.
- If you want the shortlist back at five, I can relax Docker to a nice-to-have. That would bring back CV-026 (Appium on Android). Or I can check why the other CVs were knocked out.
- If mobile experience is required, I can add it as a must-have and re-screen.

Tell me which of these you want and I'll run it.
